post.description: Order of checks: device token (401), device block (403), headers and body (400), attestation (403), intake (404/410), replay of the same Idempotency-Key (201/202), open SOS (409), phone block (403), rate limits (429, or 503 for the whole-intake breaker), availability (503), then persist and deliver. A 503 can also come after the SOS was saved, when Core refuses the relay's API key or delivery is paused before the inline attempt: the SOS is then marked failed, will never be delivered, and a replay of the same Idempotency-Key returns 201 `failed`.

nature.description: One of the intake's nature ids.

phone.description: Callback number in E.164, valid per libphonenumber-js.

location.description: A location that is out of range, 0,0, stale or in the future is dropped when an address is given, and is a 400 otherwise.

capturedAt.description: When the fix was taken (RFC 3339). At most 10 minutes old and not in the future.

address.description: Up to 500 characters after sanitising. Required when there is no usable location.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: UUID. One per SOS, reused on every retry of it.

201.description: Core created the pending call (`received`), Core rejected it for good (`failed`), or a replay of an SOS that is no longer queued. A replay of an SOS that was answered 503 after it was saved returns `failed`.

schema.description: Core created the pending call (`received`), Core rejected it for good (`failed`), or a replay of an SOS that is no longer queued. A replay of an SOS that was answered 503 after it was saved returns `failed`.

statusToken.description: Send as `X-Status-Token` to the status endpoint.

202.description: Saved; delivery is being retried (`queued`) after a timeout, network error, 409, 429 or 5xx from Core. Also a replay of an SOS still queued.

schema.description: Saved; delivery is being retried (`queued`) after a timeout, network error, 409, 429 or 5xx from Core. Also a replay of an SOS still queued.

statusToken.description: Send as `X-Status-Token` to the status endpoint.

400.description: Headers or body not valid. Do not retry.

schema.description: Headers or body not valid. Do not retry.

401.description: Device token missing, invalid or expired. Re-register, then retry with the same key.

schema.description: Device token missing, invalid or expired. Re-register, then retry with the same key.

403.description: Not allowed. No reason is given.

schema.description: Not allowed. No reason is given.

409.description: An SOS from this device is already open; its receipt and status token are returned.

schema.description: An SOS from this device is already open; its receipt and status token are returned.

statusToken.description: Send as `X-Status-Token` to the status endpoint.

503.description: Cannot take an SOS right now: delivery is paused or the relay cannot verify its Core configuration (code `unavailable`), or the whole-intake breaker tripped (code `intake_busy`). Nothing will be delivered: the SOS was either not saved, or saved and marked failed because Core refused the relay's API key during this request. Show the emergency phone number; do not auto-retry. `Retry-After` matches `retryAfterSeconds`.

schema.description: Cannot take an SOS right now: delivery is paused or the relay cannot verify its Core configuration (code `unavailable`), or the whole-intake breaker tripped (code `intake_busy`). Nothing will be delivered: the SOS was either not saved, or saved and marked failed because Core refused the relay's API key during this request. Show the emergency phone number; do not auto-retry. `Retry-After` matches `retryAfterSeconds`.

get.summary: Status of one SOS. Needs the X-Status-Token returned when the SOS was accepted.

parameters.name: x-status-token
parameters.description: The status token returned with the receipt.

reference.description: Short code the caller can quote, such as SOS-7KQ2.

updatedAt.description: Time of the last status change.

post.summary: Create an account and sign in
post.description: Creates an account and returns a session. Idempotent per `Idempotency-Key` for 24 hours: the same key and body answer 201 again with the same user and a new session; the same key with another body is 422. Limits: 5 per hour per client IP and 3 per day per phone; replays do not count. A missing or invalid `Idempotency-Key` is 400 `validation_failed` on the field `Idempotency-Key`.

email.description: Trimmed and lower-cased by the server.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A UUID v4 generated once per form submission and reused on every retry.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token for a new session
post.description: Consumes the refresh token and returns a new pair. The same token presented again within 30 s returns the same pair; later, the whole session is revoked (auth contract §3.2). Limited to 30 per hour per session.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token of the current session, as-is.

accessToken.description: Opaque to the app. Valid for 15 minutes.

refreshToken.description: Single use. Valid for 90 days from this response.

post.summary: Revoke the refresh-token family for this session.

schema.description: The refresh token whose family should be revoked.

requestBody.description: The refresh token whose family should be revoked.

204.description: Revoked, already revoked, or nothing to revoke.
